rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for either the act of portraying or the resulting description or depiction.

example.english: This novel’s portrayal of old Hong Kong neighbourhood life is very vivid.
example.traditional: 呢本小說對舊香港街坊生活嘅描寫好生動。
example.jyutping: ne1 bun2 siu2 syut3 deoi3 gau6 hoeng1 gong2 gaai1 fong1 sang1 wut6 ge3 miu4 se2 hou2 saang1 dung6

rows.note: Use this for an actor's or performer's interpretation and presentation of a character or role.

example.english: Their portrayal of this character has a lot of depth.
example.traditional: 佢今次對呢個角色嘅演繹好有層次。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam1 ci3 deoi3 ni1 go3 gok3 sik1 ge3 jin2 jik6 hou2 jau5 cang4 ci3

rows.note: Use this when a portrayal is a visual portrait, especially an image of a person.

example.english: The museum has a portrayal of the queen painted by a famous artist.
example.traditional: 博物館收藏咗一幅名畫家為皇后畫嘅肖像。
example.jyutping: bok3 mat6 gun2 sau1 cong4 zo2 jat1 fuk1 ming4 waa2 gaa1 wai6 wong4 hau6 waa6 ge3 ciu3 zoeng6
